description: Set the loaf out and did not carry the notch into the lane.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Kept the bar, gave the butter and the prison their sentence, and barred the door.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said he had heard the loom and then the knock, and sat in.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat in the Mayor's pew. He did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached the ordinance and set the glass down after one turning.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Asked whether the neighbour had seen it, named yesterday's fourpence, and went up.
name: William Shakespeare
